title: Black Poplar: Great Black Poplars You Can Visit
meta_description: Almost every European roadside poplar is a hybrid, so the native black poplar is now scarce. Four mapped, the thickest 741 centimetres round.
intro: Europe's native black poplar has been quietly bred out of its own landscape. Almost every poplar planted along a European road or river for the last two centuries has been a hybrid with an American species, so the wild form is now one of the continent's more threatened natives, and it is fast, soft and short lived on top of that. Very few reach the size of the four here. Bordeaux's has the biggest waistline in the city's entire register at 741 centimetres, three trunks fused near the ground, though its two official descriptions disagree about its height by twelve metres. Trento's made the city's monumental list in 2024 at 570 centimetres and carries no age anywhere. Venice's grows alone in a wood that took over a former military firing range on the Certosa. Setubal's pair stand beside the school named for the poet Bocage.
